hero_eyebrow: Umeed Foundation · A Ray of Hope
hero_text: We bring nutritious food, essential supplies and education to families and children who need them most — so that no one sleeps hungry, and every child gets the chance to dream.
hero_hindi: आइए, मिलकर उम्मीद की इस रोशनी को और आगे बढ़ाएं।
resolve_hi: हमारा संकल्प है – हर ज़रूरतमंद तक पौष्टिक भोजन पहुँचाना, ताकि कोई भूखा न सोये।
resolve_en: Our resolve: to bring nutritious food to everyone in need, so that no one goes to sleep hungry.
education_hi: हर बच्चा पढ़ेगा, हर सपना सजेगा।
education_en: Every child will learn. Every dream will flourish.
